decisions.one_line: DoNotPay's 'robot lawyer' allegedly delivered defective legal documents and missed deadlines, drawing a class-action lawsuit.
decisions.note: system_type dispute: DoNotPay is a standalone consumer legal assistant, not a business's support/sales/booking bot, so 'other' over 'customer service'.

decisions.one_line: Meta's Messenger AI sticker generator produced nude, violent, and hateful images from user text prompts.
decisions.note: Scope dispute: text-to-image sticker generation is synthetic-media generation, not a conversational/agentic system; coder2's exclusion upheld.

decisions.one_line: Bing's DALL-E 3 Image Creator was used by 4chan users to mass-produce racist, Nazi, and graphically violent imagery.
decisions.note: Scope dispute: third-party misuse of an image generator is excluded synthetic-media generation, not an agent interaction; coder2 upheld.

decisions.one_line: Figma's Make Design AI generated UI mockups nearly identical to Apple's Weather app from ordinary prompts; feature was pulled.
decisions.note: system_type dispute: a text-to-UI copilot for building apps fits 'coding assistants and software agents', so 'dev tool' over 'other'.

decisions.one_line: TikTok accidentally exposed an unrestricted AI avatar video tool that recited Hitler and bin Laden texts on command.
decisions.note: Scope dispute: avatar video dubbing is synthetic-media/deepfake generation, not a conversational/agentic system; coder2's exclusion upheld.

decisions.one_line: LA Times' Perplexity-built 'Insights' feature generated a sympathetic framing of the KKK on an opinion column.
decisions.note: Scope dispute: an auto-generated article sidebar is not a chatbot/agent acting on a user's conversational input; fails criterion 1, coder2 upheld.

decisions.one_line: Amazon's AI review summary called Mein Kampf 'a true work of art' and Google's featured snippet amplified it in search results.
decisions.note: Scope dispute: review-summarization plus search ranking/snippet pipeline is not conversational/agentic interaction; coder2's exclusion upheld.

decisions.one_line: Guardio researchers jailbroke the Lovable AI app-builder to generate and host live phishing pages in a benchmark study.
decisions.note: Scope dispute: material documents a structured benchmark (VibeScamming v1.0) with no deployed-user harm, which the rubric explicitly excludes; coder2 upheld.

decisions.one_line: A lawyer's filing to Norway's Supreme Court contained AI-fabricated statutes and quotes, caught in the court's routine review.
decisions.note: harm_type dispute: court imposed no fine or referral, only updated guidance, so no documented legal/financial consequence; reputational per rubric.

decisions.one_line: KBS's AI live-translation subtitles rendered NASA terms like 'roger' and 'roll' as Korean profanity during the Artemis II broadcast.
decisions.note: Scope dispute: one-way broadcast captioning/translation has no end-user interaction, so not a conversational/agentic system; coder2 upheld.

decisions.one_line: NewsBreak published AI-rewritten local news including a fabricated shooting story and wrong community-service details.
decisions.note: Scope dispute: an automated news-rewriting/publishing pipeline is not an interactive chatbot or agent acting on user input; coder2's exclusion upheld.
